_comment: CR-46: Native binary integrity manifest. Each entry maps a binary file name (as produced by scripts/build/compile_native.sh and discovered by voice_typer.server.native_hotkeys.binary_path._BINARY_NAMES) to its expected SHA-256, build version, and minimum wire-protocol version. At runtime, binary_path.verify_native_binary() hashes the discovered binary with hashlib.sha256 and compares against the sha256 field here. On mismatch, the factory logs an error and falls back to the legacy backend (pynput / WindowsNativeHotkey / WaylandHotkey). Entries with an empty sha256 (macOS / Windows binaries not built in this Linux dev tree) cause verification to be SKIPPED with a debug log — production builds MUST populate all three sha256 fields via scripts/build/update_native_manifests.py (run by CI after compile_native.sh). The min_proto_version field is reserved for future wire-protocol version gating (CR-46 follow-up); the loader does not yet enforce it.
